manifest.name: dsh-sidebar-plus
manifest.description: Sidebar file-view enhancement for DSH (zero official-file changes, hot-pluggable): a Source view for .md/.markdown — line numbers, in-file search, direct edit & save (auto backup to a configurable folder + overwrite protection), adjustable font size; find/zoom/in-place editing on the official previews; and a toolbar on the official side-by-side comparison view (one-side or both-side search, font size for both sides at once, right-side-only editing). 中文 README 见 README.md / English: README.en.md
manifest.author: sailoumili

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 中文

给 DSH 侧边栏的文件预览新增六项功能：

1. `.md` / `.markdown` 格式新增「源编辑」视图，支持 Markdown 源码着色与行号显示。
2. 新增编辑与保存功能：Markdown 格式文件可通过「编辑」跳转至「源编辑」视图进行编辑，其余文本格式在当前视图中直接编辑。
3. 所有视图新增「搜索」与「字号调节」功能。
4. 官方「纯文本」视图新增行号显示功能，可随时开启或关闭。
5. 官方「对比视图」（「本轮变更」的左右对比页）亦提供工具条：可双侧或单侧搜索、双侧同步调整字号、仅可编辑右侧。
6. 工具条行末的「⋯」设置里可改备份位置：默认 `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups`。

**不接管二进制格式**：Office（doc / docx / ppt / pptx）、表格（xls / xlsx）、PDF 与图片（png / jpg 等）由官方视图自行显示，插件不注入工具条、不提供编辑、不拦截 Ctrl+F。这些文件的内容不是文本，按文本方式打开并保存会损坏原件。判定范围以官方注册表声明的 `binaryExtensions` 为准，音视频、压缩包、可执行文件、字体等同理；`.md` / `.markdown` 与 json / yaml / txt / log / csv / svg 等文本格式处理方式不变。

**支持的 DSH 版本：`0.1.7` 及以上。**

**① 源编辑视图**（仅适用于 `.md` / `.markdown`）
在右上角「打开方式」中选择「源编辑」。该视图左侧显示行号，Markdown 语法按源码着色。官方原有的 Markdown 预览不受影响，仍可随时切回。

**② 编辑保存**（适用于所有文本格式）
- `.md` / `.markdown` 格式：点击「编辑」，跳转至「源编辑」视图进行编辑。
- 其余文本格式（json / yaml / txt / log 等）：点击「编辑」，在当前视图中直接编辑。
- 二进制格式（Office / 表格 / PDF / 图片）：不提供编辑。
- 保存：按 **Ctrl+S** 或点击「保存」；退出：按 **Esc** 或点击「退出编辑」。
- 若该文件已在别处被修改，将提示选择「强制保存」或「重载最新」。
- 覆盖前自动备份旧版本，误改后可恢复；备份位置见「设置」。
- 单个文件保存上限 32 MB，超出则拒绝保存并提示，不写盘、不动原文件。

**③ 行号开关**（官方「纯文本」视图）
在工具栏中点击「行号」，可显示或隐藏行号，默认关闭。

**④ 搜索与字号调节**（适用于所有视图）
- 搜索：按 **Ctrl+F**；**↓** 或 Enter 定位下一处，**↑** 定位上一处，**Aa** 区分大小写，**Esc** 关闭。
- 字号：点击 **A−** / **A+**，或按住 **Ctrl** 滚动滚轮调节字号；点击中间的数字可复位。

**⑤ 对比视图**（官方「本轮变更」的左右对比页）
工具条位于官方头部下方：

- **搜索**：**Ctrl+F** 打开。默认双侧；搜索行内以 **`两侧` / `左` / `右`** 限定范围，**↓ / ↑** 仅在所选范围内移动。**Aa** 区分大小写，**Esc** 关闭。
- **字号**：**A−** / **A+**，或按住 **Ctrl** 滚动滚轮；双侧同步缩放，点击中间数值恢复官方默认字号。
- **编辑右侧**（仅右侧）：
  - 左侧为本轮起始快照，只读；右侧为磁盘上的当前文件。
  - 定位：点击目标行（点左栏亦可，对应至右栏同一行）后点「编辑右侧」，光标即落在该行；编辑态亦可用工具条的 `行 [ ] 跳` 输入行号回车跳转。
  - 官方为单栏或自动换行时，先切换为左右分栏且不换行，再打开编辑器。
  - **Ctrl+S** 保存、**Esc** 退出；文件在别处被修改时提供「强制保存 / 重载最新」，覆盖前自动备份。
  - 对比页为本轮历史快照，保存文件不会使其更新。
- 单边对比（仅新增或仅删除）无左右分栏，编辑器占用整个对比区域。

**⑥ 备份路径**
工具条行末新增「⋯」按钮，点击后打开设置面板；可在设置界面内自定义备份文件夹路径，亦可点击「恢复默认」回到 `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups`。更改备份路径时，原路径内的备份文件将移动至新路径。

插件已发布到 npm（包名 `dsh-sidebar-plus`）。

**桌面端（Electron 版）——界面里输包名安装**：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件，「包名或地址」输入 `dsh-sidebar-plus`，装完按界面提示重启一次。（命令行管不了桌面端 profile，报 `managed exclusively by the Electron application` 属正常，不是出错。）

**Web 端——终端指令安装**：在 DSH 终端里执行：

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-plus
```

两端装完都需**重启 DSH 一次**。之后日常的功能改动（改 `hot-*.cjs`）自动热生效，无需再重启；只有改加载器本身才需要重启。

- 停用或卸载后重启 DSH，官方预览即恢复原样：插件不改动任何官方文件，界面也不留残余。
- 误存想要回旧内容：每次覆盖前保存的完整旧文件在备份文件夹（默认 `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups/`，可在「设置」中修改），按文件名取回即可（每个文件名保留最近 20 份）。

```
lib/index.js     宿主加载器：注册 /dsh-sp 路由 + 守卫，监视 hot-host.cjs 热装载
lib/client.js    浏览器加载器：向官方注册渲染器、正文插槽与两个不可见挂钩（文档头部、对比页），拉 hot-client.cjs 源码热替换
hot-host.cjs     宿主业务：stat / save / config / 备份 / 冲突 —— 改这个，约 2 秒生效，不重启
hot-client.cjs   浏览器业务：组件 / 文案 / 样式 / 接管扩展名名单 —— 改这个，约 2 秒生效，不刷新页面

`scripts/` 只在源码仓库里，**不随 npm 包发布**（`package.json` 的 `files` 白名单不含它）；跑自测需先克隆仓库或取源码目录。

热件编译或校验失败时保留当前版本，仅在控制台告警，页面不受影响。
在 `hot-host.cjs` 的 `handlers` 中加入同名键即可新增端点；路由为转发式，无需改动加载器。现有端点：`stat`、`save`、`mark`、`marks`、`config`（读取备份路径 / 试算 / 执行移动，试算不产生任何副作用）。

- 仅在本地 DSH 进程内读写用户主动打开的文件；**无任何外部网络请求**。
- 端点访问控制：带 Origin 的请求必须同源；保存接口只接受 POST 且内容类型必须是 `application/json`（跨源网页盲发被 CORS 预检挡死）。
- 保存前备份目录默认为 `$DSH_HOME/sidebar-plus-backups/`（即 `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups/`，本机运行数据；每个文件名留最近 20 份，总量上限 500 份），可在「设置」中改为任意绝对路径，改后的路径记在 `$DSH_HOME/sidebar-plus.config.json`。备份为该文件的**完整内容副本**，长期保留于该目录；该目录若处于使用者自有同步工具的覆盖范围内，副本将随之同步——插件自身不外发数据。
- `/dsh-sp/*` 守卫仅阻止网页跨源调用；不带 Origin 的本机进程亦可调用 `/dsh-sp/save`（仅校验绝对路径与常规文件），等同于「先备份、再覆盖本机任意文件」的写原语，与本机其他命令行工具同级，不额外授予远程能力。
- 设置存浏览器 localStorage：源编辑字号 `dsh-sidebar-plus.fontPx`、官方视图缩放 `dsh-sidebar-plus.officialZoom`、纯文本行号开关 `dsh-sidebar-plus.plainLineNo`、对比页缩放 `dsh-sidebar-plus.reviewZoom`、对比页搜索范围 `dsh-sidebar-plus.reviewFindSide`。
- 计时探针只把时间点留在进程内存里，不落盘、不外发。

1. A "Source" view for `.md` / `.markdown`, with Markdown source tinting and line numbers.
2. Edit and save: for Markdown files, "Edit" switches to the "Source" view; for all other text formats, editing takes place directly in the current view.
3. Search and font-size controls in every view.
4. A line-number toggle in the official "plain text" view, which can be switched on or off at any time.
5. A toolbar on the official comparison view (the side-by-side page for a turn's changes): search one side or both, adjust both sides' font size together, and edit the right side only.
6. The "⋯" settings button at the end of the toolbar holds the backup folder setting: `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups` by default.

**Binary formats are not handled**: Office files (doc / docx / ppt / pptx), spreadsheets (xls / xlsx), PDFs and images (png / jpg, …) are displayed by the official viewers; the plugin injects no toolbar, offers no editing and does not intercept Ctrl+F. Their content is not text, and opening then saving them as text would corrupt the original file. The scope follows the `binaryExtensions` declared in the official registry, so audio/video, archives, executables and fonts are covered the same way. Text formats such as `.md` / `.markdown`, json / yaml / txt / log / csv / svg are unaffected.
**Supported DSH versions: `0.1.7` and later.**

**① Source view** (`.md` / `.markdown` only)
Select "Source" from the "open with" menu at the top right. The view shows line numbers on the left and tints Markdown syntax in source style. The official Markdown preview is untouched and can be switched back to at any time.

**② Edit and save** (all text formats)
- `.md` / `.markdown`: click "Edit" to switch to the "Source" view.
- other text formats (json / yaml / txt / log, etc.): click "Edit" to edit directly in the current view.
- binary formats (Office / spreadsheets / PDF / images): no editing is offered.
- Save: press **Ctrl+S** or click "Save". Exit: press **Esc** or click "Exit".
- If the file has been modified elsewhere, you are asked to choose "Save anyway" or "Reload latest".
- The previous version is backed up automatically before overwriting, so accidental changes can be reverted; see Settings for the backup location.
- A single file can be up to 32 MB to save; larger files are refused with a clear message, nothing is written and the original is untouched.

**③ Line-number toggle** (official "plain text" view)
Click "行号" in the toolbar to show or hide line numbers; off by default.

**④ Search and font size** (all views)
- Search: press **Ctrl+F**; **↓** or Enter for the next match, **↑** for the previous one, **Aa** to match case, **Esc** to close.
- Font size: click **A−** / **A+**, or hold **Ctrl** and scroll; click the number in the middle to reset.

**⑤ Comparison view** (the official "changes in this turn" side-by-side page)
The toolbar sits below the official header:

- **Search**: **Ctrl+F**. Both sides by default; the **`两侧` / `左` / `右`** buttons scope it to one side, and **↓ / ↑** move only within that scope. **Aa** matches case, **Esc** closes.
- **Font size**: **A−** / **A+**, or **Ctrl**+wheel; both sides scale together, and the middle number restores the official size.
- **Edit right side** (right side only):
  - The left side is the turn-start snapshot and stays read-only; the right side is the current file on disk.
  - Position: click a comparison row (the left column also works — it maps to the same row on the right), then click "编辑右侧". Inside the editor, type a line number into `行 [ ] 跳` and press Enter.
  - In unified or wrapped mode, the view first switches to side-by-side, unwrapped.
  - **Ctrl+S** saves, **Esc** exits; if the file changed elsewhere, choose "Save anyway" or "Reload latest", and the previous version is backed up automatically.
  - The comparison is the turn's snapshot and does not update when the file is saved.
- One-sided comparisons (additions or deletions only) have no columns; the editor then fills the whole comparison area.

**⑥ Backup folder**

A "⋯" button is added at the end of the toolbar. It opens the settings panel, where the backup folder path can be customised; click "Reset" to return to `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups`. When the path is changed, the backup files in the old path are moved to the new one.

Published on npm as `dsh-sidebar-plus`.

**Desktop (Electron) — install from the UI**: Settings → Plugins → Add plugin, enter `dsh-sidebar-plus` in "package name or address", then restart once as prompted. (The CLI cannot manage the desktop profile; `managed exclusively by the Electron application` is expected, not an error.)

**Web — install by command**: from the DSH terminal:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-sidebar-plus
```

Restart DSH once after install on either flavor. Later day-to-day changes to the hot files (`hot-*.cjs`) apply live within ~2 seconds — no restart, no page refresh. Only changes to the loaders themselves need a restart.

- Disable or remove the plugin, then restart DSH: the official previews come back untouched — the plugin modifies no official file and leaves no residue in the page.
- To recover content after a wrong save: every overwrite is preceded by a full copy of the previous file in the backup folder (default `~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups/`, changeable in Settings), kept per file name (latest 20).

```
lib/index.js     host loader: registers /dsh-sp routes + guards, hot-reloads hot-host.cjs
lib/client.js    browser loader: registers the renderer, the body shell and two invisible hooks (document header, review file actions) with the official preview, pulls hot-client.cjs source and hot-swaps it
hot-host.cjs     host business: stat / save / config / backup / conflict — edit this, live in ~2s, no restart
hot-client.cjs   browser business: components / copy / styles / extension list — edit this, live in ~2s, no refresh

`scripts/` lives in the source repository only and is **not part of the npm package** (it is absent from the `files` allowlist in `package.json`); run the self-tests from a source checkout.

A broken hot file cannot break the page: if it fails to compile or validate, the previous version keeps running and only a console warning appears.

Add a same-named key to `handlers` in `hot-host.cjs`; routing is a forwarding prefix, so the loader never changes. Current endpoints: `stat`, `save`, `mark`, `marks`, and `config` (read the backup folder / dry-run / move, where the dry run has no side effects).

- Reads and writes only files the user opens, inside the local DSH process. **No external network calls.**
- Endpoint access control: requests carrying Origin must be same-origin; the save endpoint accepts POST with `application/json` only (cross-origin blind requests die at the CORS preflight).
- Pre-save backups go to `$DSH_HOME/sidebar-plus-backups/` by default (`~/.dsh/sidebar-plus-backups/`; local runtime data; latest 20 copies per file name, 500 in total) and can be set to any absolute path in Settings; the chosen path is stored in `$DSH_HOME/sidebar-plus.config.json`. A backup is a **full copy of the file**; if that directory is covered by a sync tool of your own, those copies travel with it — the plugin never sends data anywhere itself.
- The `/dsh-sp/*` guard only blocks cross-origin web pages; a local process without an Origin header can also call `/dsh-sp/save` (absolute path + regular file only), i.e. a "back up, then overwrite any local file" primitive on par with other local CLI tools, granting no remote capability.
- Settings live in browser localStorage: source-view font size `dsh-sidebar-plus.fontPx`, official-view zoom `dsh-sidebar-plus.officialZoom`, plain-text l
